content: What a treat to wake up to learn that Disney Jr's Ariel has been nominated for TWO 2027 Kidscreen awards! What a joy producing this series was. I'm so proud of our Wild Canary team, and our counterparts at ICON Creative Studio and The Walt Disney Company! While it's always sad to wrap on a production, seeing nominations like these come is a real joy!! Everyone did such fin-credible work, I'm so proud to see it continue to be recognized!
